business_problem: Encord needed an infrastructure platform that could keep pace with rapid growth in data-intensive AI workloads while staying simple enough for a small startup team to operate efficiently across geographies.
solution_summary: Encord uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Encord needed an infrastructure platform that could keep pace with rapid growth in data-intensive AI workloads while staying simple enough for a small startup team to operate efficiently across geographies. Cloud GPUs provide the training and inference horsepower customers need for faster model-development pipelines, serving as the compute layer. Compute Engine hosts the GPU-backed processing environment that can be placed near customer data for low-latency operation, serving as the compute layer. Cloud SQL stores the operational data that supports Encord’s data platform at scale, serving as the storage layer. Google Kubernetes Engine supports the broader scalable platform architecture as usage grows, serving as the orchestration layer. Gemini is being adopted to speed up Encord’s internal coding and development work, serving as the compute layer.
